svg.title: Monster semantic globe round trip
svg.desc: Exactly 194 irreducible degrees, 37,636 algebraic character values, and 221 labelled finite Moonshine prefixes move from typed semantic atlases to three globe shells and return in canonical order. Three directional arrow bands show the semantic route from irreducibles through character values to Moonshine prefixes. Twenty-four animated point-level arrows trace twelve sampled individual record chains. The embedded checked archive recovers every value and all 8,501 supplied Moonshine coefficients.
svg.text: SEMANTIC RECORDS → THREE-SHELL GLOBE → THE SAME RECORDS · 24-second lossless loop
